question: Which architecture should an AI engineering organization standardize on to turn coding-agent swarms into trustworthy, directly-delivering teams?

options.name: Thin Protocol + Cross-Vendor Judge + Hard Git/CI Gates
options.summary: Keep execution on native coding harnesses (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity) while enforcing deterministic Git-tree receipts, premise-attack exit gates, and cross-vendor Critic/Actor/Judge separation.
pros: Zero lock-in as native coding harnesses evolve weekly
Deterministic exit-code gates prevent stale-test pushes and self-grading bias
Protects human attention by batching strategic decisions
cons: Requires disciplined record schema and cross-vendor model availability
flip_triggers: A single vendor natively ships verifiable cross-model adversarial judging with exact-tree CI locks
Overhead of cross-vendor verification exceeds 30% of human review time on routine tickets

options.name: Custom Multi-Agent State-Machine Orchestrator
options.summary: Build and maintain a bespoke stateful orchestrator that programmatically decides convergence, retries, and branch merges.
pros: Fine-grained central control over every state transition
cons: Edge-case branch explosion and subtle false verdicts (Lesson L-0002)
Constant maintenance drag chasing native CLI harness updates
flip_triggers: Formal verification proves <1% false-verdict rate across 50+ real multi-round deliveries

options.name: Single-Vendor Retry Loop (while true + unit tests)
options.summary: Run one coding agent in a retry loop until local tests return exit 0.
pros: Fastest setup for small toy tasks and single-file scripts
cons: High test-gaming risk and blind premise-drift retries
Drags human owners back into continuous terminal babysitting
flip_triggers: Zero-shot model reliability eliminates silent compromise and premise drift on multi-file repos

claims.text: Cross-vendor Critic/Actor/Judge separation + exact-tree CI gates catch regressions missed by same-model retries.
claims.reason: Verified across production loops and independent cross-vendor audits.

claims.text: Two-layer JEV decision-model routing cuts LLM deep-read token cost by >60% without dropping conflicting signals.
claims.reason: Layer-1 noul screening with ROUTE_DROP_BELOW=0.35 preserves ambiguous conflicts while dropping clear noise.

claims.text: Centralized custom orchestrators outperform thin protocols on long-horizon multi-repo engineering teams.
claims.reason: Direct conflict: OpenHands/workflow benchmarks show structured dispatch gains, while L-0002 documented false verdicts and orchestrator bloat.
